newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Adelaide street up for sale.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Adelaide street up for sale.

text.p: An entire Adelaide city street, complete with 10 commercial buildings including four heritage-listed sites, is to be offered for sale.

Andrew McIntyre, associate state director with Jones Lang Wootton, said in a statement the Leigh Street portfolio provided just over 17,000 square metres of lettable accommodation and a total development potential of about 50,000 square metres.

Leigh Street, connecting Hindley and Currie streets in the heart of Adelaide's business and entertainment precinct, has been owned by the Leigh Trust for more than 150 years, with income supporting the Anglican Church, the statement said.
Archbishop Ian George said the trust considered the portfolio ripe for redevelopment but its expertise did not lie in that area and it believed it should diversify its interests.
George said existing tenants would be offered the first right to purchase the properties they were now leasing.
McIntyre said it was almost impossible to estimate a value for the holding, given the variety of redevelopment options available in an offering which was unique in Australia.
